name: auto-activity
description: Generates cursor movement, word selection, scrolling, searching, file opening and mouse movement on a timer. Never creates, saves or modifies files.

autoActivity.minSeconds.description: Shortest wait between two of the other actions (cursor move, search, open/close file), in seconds.

autoActivity.maxSeconds.description: Longest wait between two of the other actions (cursor move, search, open/close file), in seconds.

autoActivity.selectScrollMinSeconds.description: Shortest wait between two select-and-scroll steps, in seconds.

autoActivity.selectScrollMaxSeconds.description: Longest wait between two select-and-scroll steps, in seconds.

autoActivity.moveCursor.description: Move the cursor to a nearby line in the active editor.

autoActivity.scroll.description: Scroll the active editor as part of the select-and-scroll step.

autoActivity.selectWord.description: Select a whole word near the cursor as part of the select-and-scroll step.

autoActivity.search.description: Open the Find box with a word from the file, step through a few matches, then close it. Never replaces text.

autoActivity.switchTabs.description: Occasionally switch to the next open editor tab.

autoActivity.openCloseFiles.description: Open files from the project folder shown in the Explorer, and close them again later. Only tabs opened by this extension are closed.

autoActivity.moveMouse.description: Move the real mouse pointer along curved paths in short sessions (Windows only). Only moves the pointer; never clicks. Stops a session as soon as you move the mouse yourself.

autoActivity.mousePauseMinSeconds.description: Shortest pause between two mouse-movement sessions, in seconds.

autoActivity.mousePauseMaxSeconds.description: Longest pause between two mouse-movement sessions, in seconds.

autoActivity.mousePauseWhenUnfocused.description: Do not move the mouse while the VS Code window is not focused.

autoActivity.showStatusBar.description: Show the icon-only toggle button in the status bar.

autoActivity.startOnLaunch.description: Start generating activity as soon as VS Code opens.
